LESSON: REFORMS INTRODUCED BY PROPHET MUHAMMAD

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad
2. Practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad in the examples.
2. Explain Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad
2. Practise Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
